items.rendering_style: clean hand-pixeled 2D RPG creature sprite, crisp clusters, selective anti-aliasing, limited color ramp, no painterly texture
items.view_instruction: three-quarter side view facing screen-right, full body visible, readable silhouette, centered with twelve percent breathing room
items.lighting_instruction: single soft upper-left key light, one shadow ramp and one highlight ramp per material, no dramatic rim light
items.background_instruction: transparent background represented as clean alpha, no environment, no floor plane, no cast shadow
composition_rules: feet and extremities remain inside the canvas
eye and signature features remain legible at one-to-one scale
use large intentional pixel clusters instead of noisy single pixels
